about_the_game:
The Clown's Forest: Whispers of Insanity© is a survival horror action-adventure game built in RPG Maker MZ and is a prequel to The Clown's Forest 2: Waking Shadows© (Will contain spoilers for The Clown's Forest, This game is best played after beating the first game)

STORY

Blitzo lost control while hunting down Michael. Jonathan had slipped back into control momentarily. Blitzo taunts Jonathan, vowing to destroy him once and for all. Jonathan, stuck in his own body and his own mind, with no way out, has to figure out how to keep himself safe in what was once his own subconscious. Jonathan's mind is slowly dwindling but he has to become stronger than Blitzo himself.

Forcing himself to relive his worst memories and fabrications created by Blitzo, Jonathan has to survive his nightmares to ensure he continues to exist to aid Michael in any way he can. But Blitzo refuses to make it easy for him.

GAMEPLAY

The Clown's Forest: Whispers of Insanity© Is a top-down Survival Horror game set between the events of The Clown's Forest© and The Clown's Forest 2: Waking Shadows©, Jonathan has to survive his own nightmares to come out on top of Blitzo. Explore familiar and not so familiar locations fabricated by Jonathan's shared subconscious with Blitzo as Blitzo tries destroying Jonathan's soul from the inside.

Puzzles return with more terrifying consequences and new characters and lore will be expanded on as Jonathan not only fights against his past, but also the longhurst family's past as a whole. 

Jonathan has to protect himself from Blitzo. No matter the cost.

content_descriptors.notes:
This game contains gore, violence, zombie-like creatures, and strong language.

References to Suicide, Drugs, Alcohol, and Sexual Content will appear in relevant places in the game.
